title: How to use ChatGPT to negotiate your salary

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How might ChatGPT and similar tools reshape the way we negotiate salaries in the coming years?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: ChatGPT can analyze job market data, suggest negotiation tactics, and simulate employer responses to help users prepare.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But relying on AI for such personal negotiations risks dehumanizing the process and may reinforce biased wage structures.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are adding transparency layers and bias-detection tools to ensure AI recommendations are fair and context-aware.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In the future, AI could act as a neutral mediator, helping both employees and employers reach equitable agreements.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of salary negotiation may be smarter, fairer, and more collaborative — powered by thoughtful AI design.

video_cue: A diverse group of professionals using an AI assistant to review salary data and negotiate with employers in a virtual meeting room.
